Record Class MatrixGrid

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.MatrixGrid
Record Components:
count - number of fitted cells
firstCenter - center of the first cell relative to the span start
step - distance between neighboring centers; zero for fewer than two cells
cellSize - fitted cell extent along this axis
public record MatrixGrid(int count, float firstCenter, float step, float cellSize) extends Record
Packs equally sized Matrix cells along a span without squeezing individual glyph shapes.

  • Method Details

    • fit

      public static MatrixGrid fit(float span, float cellSize, float minimumPadding, int limit)
      Fits as many cells as permitted, then distributes leftover space evenly between them.

      A span narrower than one nominal cell shrinks that cell to fit. A zero span produces no cells. The same rule supports horizontal columns and vertical rows.

      Parameters:
      span - finite nonnegative available GUI extent
      cellSize - finite positive nominal cell extent
      minimumPadding - finite nonnegative minimum gap between cells
      limit - positive maximum number of cells
      Returns:
      fitted grid relative to the supplied span's origin
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any bound is invalid or nonfinite

    • center

      public float center(int index)
      Finds one fitted cell's center relative to the span origin.
      Parameters:
      index - zero-based cell index
      Returns:
      firstCenter plus index times step
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if index is outside the fitted count

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
